verdict.rationale: Anrok documents a broad public API covering customers, transactions (create, ephemeral, void, negation), certificate upload "via the Anrok UI as well as via the API", filings retrieval, product mappings and address resolution, and its Headless Tax page says all five jobs can run through its APIs or agents. However, no documentation states full UI parity, and UI features such as registration handling, exposure alerts, nexus tracking and filing/payment management have only read or no evident API coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of registrations, alerts and nexus tracking, and independent or hands-on confirmation that UI workflows can be fully automated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Certificates can be uploaded to Anrok via the Anrok UI as well as via the API.
Run tax through Anrok's APIs, or hand it to your agents. One engine powers all five jobs, and Headless Tax makes it reachable wherever your team already works.
This endpoint can be used to fetch filings from Anrok.
Use Anrok's Transactions API to synchronize transactions between Anrok and your billing system, as well as calculate sales tax for new invoices.
